name: Descope
description: Authentication platform with an Agentic Identity Hub: secures MCP servers and APIs for agents, and vaults users' OAuth tokens and API keys for the tools agents call on their behalf.

skills.name: Secure MCP Servers
skills.description: Adds managed OAuth authentication and scope-based authorization to MCP servers and APIs that agents connect to.

skills.name: Vault Users' OAuth Tokens
skills.description: Stores, refreshes and hands out users' or tenants' OAuth tokens and API keys for third-party services through Connections.

skills.name: Agent Auth SDK
skills.description: Lets an agent fetch short-lived, scope-limited credentials to call MCP servers and APIs on a user's behalf (Python and TypeScript).
